test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different.

Select the letter-cluster that is different. (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is: ​

Option (1): ZABX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb723142b8ed82901224f3a36f0f67e4f282d9453fb549a721c7366c532d9e5f.png] 

Option (2): KPQJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac8dc7be2f1f3b17597d6a7c0ce1606abe03d5ab3b18f92ae43bd2a2470bccfd.png] 

Option (3): NMNM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15bb14545449bf1916181e170b8864678d3e52e1d81be7408f9ff99ce32dea6a.png] 

Option (4): TGHS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c90a4f21a1df601b1d0f45b8e3458d5c0e2af616a899df092653bcac3feb4140.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "ZABX" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
